messages:
sara: Heads-up: linkcheck failing on the 'troubleshooting' page. Broken fragment to a heading that contains an emoji and a soft-hyphen in the text.

link-bot: linkcheck: ERROR: Fragment not found: /docs/troubleshooting#restart-–-soft‑hyphen

tom: Wait, soft-hyphen? Those are invisible (U+00AD) and can sneak into copy from Word or exported docs. Emoji also get normalized differently between slugifiers (some strip, some transliterate).

sara: Minimal repro in MDX: 
```mdx
## Restart —AD soft
Next steps...

## Restart — soft
```
First heading renders an anchor with an encoded soft-hyphen in the id on staging, second one becomes the same visible text but different id, linkcheck complains about duplicate/absent fragment.

michael: I saw similar where emoji like :fire: in a heading became either `fire` or removed, depending on build. Combined with invisible chars the slug collisions are nasty.

link-bot: build failed (docusaurus): duplicate fragment id 'restart-–-soft' found, linkcheck exit 1.

tom: Quick triage: run `git grep -n "\u00AD" docs || true` and also `git grep -n "emoji" docs | sed -n '1,50p'` to find suspicious headings.

sara: Found two pages with stray soft-hyphens and three headings that include emoji. I'll patch the soft-hyphens and add a linter rule to strip-control-chars from MDX headings.

michael: For emoji, let's pick a canonical behavior: remove emoji from headings before slugify and add a lint warning suggesting authors move emoji to the body or alt text. That keeps slugs stable.

tom: Implementation plan: 1) remark plugin to normalize headings (strip/control-char-cleanup + remove emoji codepoints), 2) repo-wide fix for current hits, 3) add remark-lint rule to fail on control chars or emoji in headings.

docs-ci: CI queued for PR 4755 (strip soft-hyphen + emoji heading normalize + lint).

sara: I'm opening the PR with the fixes and a tiny migration note for authors who might have copied content from Google Docs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4755

michael: Added a unit test for the heading normalizer showing `normalize('Restart —\u00AD soft 🔥') -> restart-soft`.

link-bot: build started for PR 4755 (docusaurus build + linkcheck).

tom: Local linkcheck before patch: 5 broken fragments; after repo fixes: 0. Also added a small staging redirect for the few customer-facing anchors that might have been bookmarked.

docs-ci: build passed for PR 4755 :white_check_mark: linkcheck OK.

sara: Merged. I've posted a short migration note in #migration and updated CONTRIBUTING.md with the 'no emoji in headings' guidance and a small note about invisible control characters.

michael: Nice work. If we still see anchor noise we can add a docs-health alert for spikes in fragment 404s.

sara: Closing this thread. Ping me if anyone sees regressions. :wave:
